intro: Oil is Chad's main export, but most people farm and herd.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Oil is exported through a pipeline to Cameroon's coast. Cotton, gum arabic and livestock are also important.

chapters.title: Poverty
text: Chad is one of the poorest countries in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A tree sap used in food.

cardGroups.title: Made in Chad
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Chad makes and sells to the world.
